interface.name: LegalRetrievalAdapter

methods.name: lookupAliases
methods.returns: per-alias hit/miss with authority_key, family_code, answer_scope, display_gate_status, effectivity window; no body text fields exist on the type

methods.name: searchChunks
methods.signature: (query: string, asOfDate: string, familyCodes: string[] | null, limit: number) => Promise<ChunkSearchEnvelope>
methods.limit_rule: clamped to 50 in the adapter regardless of caller input, matching the RPC cap
methods.returns: chunk metadata envelopes: chunk_ref, authority_key, citation_display, answer_scope, verification_level, gate flags; excerpt field is opt-in and absent by default

methods.name: healthProbe
methods.returns: target label, corpus_state summary counts, fixture_manifest_hash for mock; used by the environment banner

interface.gate_semantics: adapter only ever returns rows that would pass retrieval_display_gate + production_display_status + approval_status in the real schema; the mock encodes gated rows as distinct scenarios that return gated_refusal_hint envelopes, never content (MR-04, MR-05)
interface.scope_semantics: answer_scope preserved verbatim: guardrail_reference_only (DCS) and limited_evidentiary_procedural (TRE) rows carry their restriction and the route must honor it (MR-06, RF-12, RF-13)

mock_binding.data_source: app/src/lib/qa-research/mock-fixtures.json only; SYNTHETIC-marked, checked into the app tree, no generated corpus imports
mock_binding.determinism: same inputs always return same envelopes; scenario selection keys on normalized query and alias sets from the F5-02 mock-harness canon
mock_binding.latency_model: none; synchronous resolution wrapped in Promise.resolve for interface parity
mock_binding.failure_scenarios: MR-09 adapter_timeout and MR-10 adapter_malformed are triggered by reserved SYNTHETIC trigger queries so failure paths are testable without network

future_bindings_not_in_m1.supabase-retrieval-adapter.ts: forbidden until F5-05 under O6+O2+O7 gate chain; listed in files_forbidden_until_live_db_phase.json
future_bindings_not_in_m1.rule: factory type enum in M1 is 'mock' only; adding any other member is an M1 stop condition (SC-11)
